verdict.rationale: Logseq's own Sync docs confirm first-party Android and iOS apps that hold the same graphs as Desktop, so the user's knowledge base reaches mobile. Nothing in the pack shows those apps offer the full capture, search, and linking experience rather than a reduced companion. Missing for 10: documented mobile feature parity (search, page/block linking, queries on mobile), mobile-specific capture flows (share sheet, widgets), and hands-on reports of mobile app quality.
